scripts.start:backend:dev: pnpm run configproxy && nx serve nest-app --watch
scripts.start:backend:portless: pkill -f 'nx serve nest-app --watch' || true; pkill -f 'portless run --name api.dev' || true; PORTLESS_BACKEND_URL=https://api.dev.localhost pnpm run configproxy && pnpm exec portless run --name api.dev --app-port 3000 --force env NX_DAEMON=false pnpm nx serve nest-app --watch
scripts.start:frontend:dev: pnpm run configangular -- --environment=dev && pnpm run update-project-port && dotenvx run -- nx serve frontend/app-jcm
scripts.start:frontend:portless: pkill -f 'nx serve frontend/app-jcm' || true; pkill -f 'portless run --name dev' || true; PORTLESS_BACKEND_URL=https://api.dev.localhost PORTLESS_FRONTEND_URL=https://dev.localhost pnpm run configangular -- --environment=dev && PORTLESS_BACKEND_URL=https://api.dev.localhost pnpm run configproxy && pnpm run update-project-port && pnpm exec portless run --name dev --app-port 4000 --force env NX_DAEMON=false pnpm nx serve frontend/app-jcm --host=127.0.0.1
scripts.start:portless:all: pnpm run stop:portless:all >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; PORTLESS_BACKEND_URL=https://api.dev.localhost PORTLESS_FRONTEND_URL=https://dev.localhost pnpm run configangular -- --environment=dev && PORTLESS_BACKEND_URL=https://api.dev.localhost pnpm run configproxy && pnpm run update-project-port && (nohup env NX_DAEMON=false pnpm nx serve nest-app --watch > /tmp/nest-portless.log 2>&1 &) && pnpm exec portless alias api.dev 3000 --force && (nohup pnpm exec portless run --name dev --app-port 4000 --force env NX_DAEMON=false pnpm nx serve frontend/app-jcm --host=127.0.0.1 > /tmp/frontend-portless.log 2>&1 &) && echo 'Portless stack started (logs: /tmp/nest-portless.log, /tmp/frontend-portless.log)'
scripts.stop:portless:all: pkill -f 'nx serve nest-app --watch' || true; pkill -f 'nx serve frontend/app-jcm' || true; pkill -f 'portless run --name dev' || true; pnpm exec portless alias --remove api.dev || true; pnpm exec portless prune || true
scripts.status:portless:all: echo '=== Portless Routes ===' && pnpm exec portless list && echo '' && echo '=== HTTP Checks (with retry) ===' && curl -k -I --retry 20 --retry-delay 1 --retry-all-errors https://dev.localhost && curl -k -I --retry 20 --retry-delay 1 --retry-all-errors https://api.dev.localhost && echo '' && echo '=== Backend Log (tail) ===' && tail -n 20 /tmp/nest-portless.log 2>/dev/null || true && echo '' && echo '=== Frontend Log (tail) ===' && tail -n 20 /tmp/frontend-portless.log 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.start:prisma: pnpm run prisma:generate && pnpm run prisma-migrate
scripts.prisma:generate: dotenvx run -- pnpm exec prisma generate
scripts.prisma:generate:watch: dotenvx run -- pnpm exec prisma generate --watch
scripts.prisma-migrate: dotenvx run -- pnpm exec prisma migrate dev
